C1087.title: Traffic Diversion Scam Nets Over 2 Million Yuan, 11 Arrested
C1087.summary: In August 2024, a criminal gang was reported to have recruited retail investors with an interest in stock trading into traffic diversion groups, earning 200 yuan per person added. This facilitated subsequent fraud operations and generated over 2 million yuan in illicit profits. Police have arrested 11 individuals involved.

references.title: Over 2 million yuan earned from 'traffic generation' for scams, 11 already arrested!
